command.start: Start: tell Pebble about the project
command.init: Read the bootstrap and propose the plan
command.tests: Suggested tests for the open file
command.path.reveal: Open the task in the path
command.path.verify: Check the path with tests and compiler
command.path.planNext: Prepare the next step of the path
command.scaffoldFile: Prepare the file: signatures and pseudocode
config.language: Pebble's language: the interface, the texts it writes (path, skeletons, bootstrap) and the model's answers.
config.language.enum0: Follows VS Code's language (Italian if VS Code is in Italian, English otherwise)
config.experienceLevel: Your experience level: it changes what Pebble flags and how it explains it.
config.experienceLevel.enum0: I'm learning to program: simple explanations, terms explained, concrete steps
config.experienceLevel.enum1: I can program but have little project experience: the why, with the principles named
config.experienceLevel.enum3: Expert: only bugs, ADR violations and trade-offs, terse answers
config.provider.enum2: Local model with an OpenAI-compatible API (Ollama, LM Studio, llama.cpp)
config.anthropic.effort: How much Claude reasons: higher = more accurate, slower and more expensive answers.
config.openai.model: OpenAI model to use (required if the provider is OpenAI).
config.local.baseUrl: Address of the local server's OpenAI-compatible API. Ollama: http://localhost:11434/v1 · LM Studio: http://localhost:1234/v1
config.local.model: Local model name (e.g. the one you see with `ollama list`).
config.monthlyBudgetUsd: Monthly budget in dollars. When you go over it, Pebble warns you and the status bar turns yellow. 0 = no budget.
config.prices: Prices for models Pebble doesn't know (e.g. OpenAI), in dollars per million tokens. Example: `{ "gpt-6.2-sol": { "input": 2, "output": 8, "cacheRead": 0.2 } }`. Claude prices are already included.
config.autoStart: When you open a project with bootstrap.md but without .pebble/, Pebble reads it and proposes the plan (once per project).
config.guideNewFiles: When you create a file in a project with .pebble/, Pebble tells you its role and what to avoid.
config.path.testCommand: Command that runs the tests and prints the results in TAP format, run in the project folder. If you leave the default, Pebble picks one from package.json (Vitest included). Examples: `node --test --test-reporter=tap "test/**/*.test.ts"`, `npx vitest run --reporter=tap-flat`.
config.path.testTimeoutSeconds: Maximum time for the tests run by the path, in seconds.
config.path.verifyOnSave: When you save a project file, rerun the tests and update the path's boxes. It doesn't use the model and costs nothing.
config.path.requireRedFirst: A task closes only if Pebble has seen its tests fail at least once (ADR-010). Off: the task closes with a warning.
description: Walk the path. You write the code. A pair engineer in your editor: it plans the path, prepares the structure, checks your work with your tests and helps you think.
